warden: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset, transparent 1024x1024 PNG atlas for an ORIGINAL top-down space survival action game STACKFALL. Four isolated mechanical parts in a strict 2x2 grid, each entirely inside its own 512x512 cell with at least 48px clear transparent padding. No grid lines, no labels, no text, no background, no drop shadows. Orthographic nearly top-down view with a very small front bevel visible; consistent light from upper left. NOT a robot humanoid, NOT a U-shaped gate. An aged industrial space quarantine guardian built as a heavy armored tug. Upper left cell: broad compact wedge-shaped armored main chest, wide 3:2 aspect, layered solid blue-grey titanium plates, ochre ceramic cap, recessed dark vents, worn bevels and chipped paint, contained warm amber power slit at center, thick structural mass. Upper right cell: its LEFT hydraulic crushing arm, narrow vertical 1:2 aspect, broad shoulder hinge at top, exposed steel piston through middle, heavy squared wedge clamp at lower end, same palette. Lower left cell: its RIGHT broken salvage arm, narrow vertical 1:2 aspect, hinge at top, exposed cylinder and a split heavy jaw at bottom, asymmetric torn plating, same palette. Lower right cell: recessed reactor core cartridge, narrow 3:4 aspect, hot white amber internal reactor behind mechanical metal housing and dark insulation, subtle emission only at interior. Render detailed hand-painted 3D game sprites with physically believable metallic surface planes, oxidation, bolts, occlusion, readable large shapes. At small size these must read as substantial industrial machinery. No uniform outlines, no wireframes, no neon contour, no rings, no floating decoration, no copies of any existing game. Exact four components only, each fully separated for independent runtime articulation.
structures: Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL production 2D game asset atlas for STACKFALL space industrial collapse frontier, transparent PNG. Four isolated standalone props in four well-separated rows, all complete with generous transparent padding; no labels, no text, no background or detached debris. Orthographic almost top-down view, light upper left. Painterly realistic 3D sprites, solid surfaces, chipped ochre paint, cold steel blue grey, deep dark occlusion, restrained highlights, detailed brushed metal, no outlined vector art. Row 1 upper quarter: a long thick horizontal solid blast shutter door, 5:1 aspect ratio, interlocking ribbed plates, thick rails, heavy actuators, ochre industrial safety caps. Row 2 second quarter: long horizontal damaged support I-beam with triangular metal web struts, 6:1 aspect, heavy structure and bent chipped end. Row 3 third quarter: wide fractured landing-route deck segment, 4:1 aspect ratio, rough torn plate ends, solid anti-slip top surface, yellow muted hazard stripe embedded in surface, clear 3D depth bevel and underside. Row 4 bottom quarter: broad low armored quarantine gate silhouette with two short attached end pillars and horizontal roof joining them, a genuine space facility, 4:1 aspect ratio, blank dark open passage, mounted cyan indicator lamps only on pillars. Each prop row separated by transparent margin. Must fit wholly inside image, not cropped. No neon edges, no concentric rings, no uniform outlines, no CAD schematic, no glow replacing surface. These are game sprites intended to sit inside a navigable space, not illustration scenes.
transparencyEditIntent: Remove the background from the provided industrial prop atlas. Preserve all four props, their spacing, colors, texture, viewpoint and exact geometry. Keep all pixels outside the four props fully transparent; do not add any content.
